thread:
maria.ae: Quick sync — Acme Fin wants a 3-week POC. Key asks: document search + Q&A, reranking top results, and a tool call to fetch customer balances. Need alignment on success criteria, model fit (context length + tool calling), and rough pricing for hosted vs dedicated.

ben.se: Got it. Do they want full doc context (32k) or chunk + embeddings?

maria.ae: They say "upload entire monthly statements" and want answers that reference exact paragraph. Prefer minimal infra lift (hosted first).

jordan.ml: If they need paragraph-level attribution with the full statement preserved in-context, 32k context model is easiest. Otherwise embeddings + rerank is cheaper and often higher precision for specific Qs.

lisa.cs: Security questions: customer requires SSO (SAML), KMS-managed keys, and logs for audit. Also data residency in eu-west-1. Any blockers for hosted?

ben.se: Hosted supports KMS + SAML for enterprise plans. Data residency we can pin region for dedicated; hosted EU region is an option but need SOC2 addendum. I'll confirm with infra.

maria.ae: Pricing ask: rough hosted token cost estimate and delta to reserved Dedicated for three-month POC (50k queries, avg 800 tokens in/out).

jordan.ml: Back-of-envelope: hosted with rw-infer-gpt-32k (quantized) ~ $X per 1M tokens; embeddings for chunking + reranker pairs ~ lower per-query token cost but adds embedding unit cost. For 50k queries @ 800 tokens that's ~40M tokens. We should give both: (A) 32k model hosted; (B) chunk+embed+rerank hosted; (C) Dedicated small pool pricing.

lisa.cs: On compliance: we need to confirm retention policy — customer wants logs for 90 days and no training on customer data. Hosted supports no-training flag and retention controls on enterprise plan. I'll attach standard language for the DPA.

maria.ae: Ok. Also need acceptance criteria for POC. Suggested minimal set: 1) 90% exactness on 200 eval prompts (benchmarked), 2) end-to-end latency <= 800ms p50 for Qs, 3) reranker improves top-1 precision by >= 15% vs embeddings-only baseline, 4) tool call returns correct account payload >= 98%. Thoughts?

jordan.ml: Those are solid. Slight tweak: measure latency both for cold (no cache) and warm (with KV cache). Also make eval prompts a mix of short Qs and long-context referential prompts. I'll draft an eval harness.

ben.se: For reranker architecture, recommend a bi-phase: embeddings index with ANN (faiss) for recall -> lightweight reranker (smaller decoder) for precision. We can simulate locally. For tool calls, we should test failure modes (timeouts, partial payload). Add rollback policy: if toolcall fails, model falls back to clarifying question.

maria.ae: Can you draft an example harness snippet I can share with customer?

jordan.ml: Sure. Example config block to run evaluation:

```
# eval_config.yaml
eval_set: acme_statements_200
model_candidates:
  - rw-infer-gpt-32k
  - rw-infer-gpt-8k + embeddings-rerank
metrics:
  - exact_match
  - top1_precision
  - latency_p50
  - toolcall_success_rate
requests_per_eval: 200
timeout_ms: 12000
```

ben.se: Nice. Also propose A/B rollout plan: week 1 synthetic evals + internal demo, week 2 small customer sandbox (one team), week 3 extended load + go/no-go meeting. That fits 3-week ask if schedules align.

lisa.cs: Action items for me: confirm SAML+KMS + retention clauses and share DPA snippet by EOD tomorrow.

maria.ae: Action items for Ben/Jordan: 1) cost estimates for hosted vs dedicated POC by EOD today, 2) share eval harness and sample results by tomorrow, 3) prepare a short demo notebook showing rerank lift.

ben.se: On it. I'll produce two cost scenarios and include a short note about expected cost drivers (context length, batching, caching).

jordan.ml: I'll run the initial embedding+rerank sim on a 1k-sample to produce an expected top1 improvement number.

maria.ae: Thanks. Quick Q from customer: can we support function/tool calling to their internal API that requires client-cert mTLS?

lisa.cs: We support outbound secure connections from Dedicated via customer-provided NAT/VPC peering. Hosted can call external APIs but mTLS with client certs is only available via Private (VPC) deployments today. Need to surface that to customer as a constraint.

maria.ae: Perfect — I'll flag that as a blocker for hosted (but ok if they consider Dedicated).

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: POC sandbox cluster reserved for acme-trial on 1965435600 -> notifies when ready.

maria.ae: Thanks all — I'll send the customer the POC acceptance checklist (with your tweaks) and proposed timeline. Follow-ups: Ben please cc infra when you share pricing, Jordan add the eval results to the thread.

ben.se: Will do.

jordan.ml: Will post initial sim numbers by tomorrow morning.

lisa.cs: DPA snippet incoming.

maria.ae: Closing loop here. :thumbsup:
